description: This PHP source file defines the StudioParser class, which provides functionality for parsing, manipulating, and generating HTML forms and layouts within the SuiteCRM Studio environment. It includes methods for parsing view files, handling form controls, and integrating with the SugarCRM framework.

classes.name: StudioParser
classes.description: A class providing parsing, manipulation, and generation of HTML layout files in the SuiteCRM Studio environment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns and optionally sets the current file type based on its specific name.

methods.name: getParsers
methods.description: Determines the appropriate parser classes for a given filename based on its naming pattern.

methods.name: parseRows
methods.description: Parses HTML table rows from a string.

methods.name: parseNames
methods.description: Extracts 'name' attributes from HTML input elements within a string.

methods.name: parseLabels
methods.description: Extracts label placeholders from a string based on MOD and APP label patterns.

methods.name: getMaxPosition
methods.description: Calculates the maximum position index from the current positions array.

methods.name: parsePositions
methods.description: Parses position-related data embedded within span elements in HTML content.

methods.name: parseCols
methods.description: Parses HTML table cell ('td') elements from a string.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main parse function that initiates position parsing.

methods.name: positionCount
methods.description: Counts span elements with 'sugar' attributes in an HTML string.

methods.name: rowCount
methods.description: Counts table row ('tr') elements in an HTML string.

methods.name: loadFile
methods.description: Loads a specified file's contents into the parser object, initializing the form template.

methods.name: generateButtons
methods.description: Generates an array of form action buttons with associated images and scripts.

methods.name: getFormButtons
methods.description: Returns HTML for form action buttons.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Returns the accumulated form HTML with closing tags.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Retrieves metadata file definitions for a given module, optionally by file ID.

methods.name: getWorkingFile
methods.description: Returns a path to a working copy of a file, copying it to a working directory if needed.

methods.name: getSwapWith
methods.description: Calculates the swap index for reordering slots.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes form submissions to rearrange or modify layout fields and saves the updated layout.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Saves modified content to a specified file, optionally processing special content like search forms.

methods.name: handleSaveLabels
methods.description: Saves label changes for a module via LabelEditor.

methods.name: disableInputs
methods.description: Removes input controls from HTML to disable editing.

methods.name: enableLabelEditor
methods.description: Adds inline label editing capabilities to labels.

methods.name: writeToCache
methods.description: Caches the generated view into a file and updates associated templates.

methods.name: populateRequestFromBuffer
methods.description: Populates $_REQUEST from a buffer of HTML content, extracting form input names.

methods.name: cacheXTPL
methods.description: Creates a cached version of an XTemplate file with dynamic content.

methods.name: yahooJS
methods.description: Generates JavaScript for drag-and-drop functionality using YUI library.

methods.name: addSlotToForm
methods.description: Adds a hidden input for a slot to the form HTML.

methods.name: prepSlots
methods.description: Prepares layout slots for drag-and-drop editing, generating appropriate HTML.

methods.name: parseOldestFile
methods.description: Loads and parses the oldest backup of a file for comparison or restoration purposes.

methods.name: clearWorkingDirectory
methods.description: Removes the working directory used for temporary layout files.

methods.name: upgradeToSmarty
methods.description: Converts the current layout content to use Smarty template syntax.
